subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw own synchronization of Control UI-originated turns into Open WebUI's persistent visible chat history, and through which boundary?
rationale: Current OpenClaw code owns transcript/context, while the proposed fix crosses into Open WebUI's third-party persistence model and likely needs a supported config/API/doctor/plugin boundary before implementation.

options.title: Define a supported sync boundary
options.body: Approve a narrow Open WebUI integration boundary and require live Docker/Open WebUI proof before a fix PR changes persistence behavior.

options.title: Keep transcript-only ownership
options.body: Document or decide that OpenClaw owns only its transcript/model context and should not mutate Open WebUI visible history.

options.title: Allow direct DB mirroring
options.body: Permit core gateway code to mirror into Open WebUI SQLite only with explicit config, upgrade/backfill handling, and live proof.

recommendation.title: Define a supported sync boundary
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow Open WebUI integration boundary and require live Docker/Open WebUI proof before a fix PR changes persistence behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The current central gateway paths route through the code Vincent Koc most recently touched in this checkout, and the decision is gateway/session-boundary specific.
